title: Endpoint Portfolios PRD + Go‑Live Gambit
creator: Ava Martinez
description: PRD for a new product surface called 'Endpoint Portfolios' that lets customers compose chat, completion, embedding and rerank operations in a single declarative request bundle. Goal: reduce network round trips for multi-step flows, enable atomic rollback/fallback semantics, and provide unified telemetry and cost attribution for composed workloads.
background: Several enterprise customers use a mix of chat/completions/embeddings/rerank in chained pipelines. Each hop creates latency, brittle error handling, and fractured cost telemetry. We've prototyped server-side composition in a research spike (runtime-1.22 branch) and validated 20-40% p50 latency reduction on typical search+rerank flows. This PRD formalizes a product to ship hosted Portfolio endpoints with operational controls and launch criteria.
goals: Expose a single /v1/portfolio endpoint that accepts a declarative JSON graph of up to 6 sub-requests
Preserve existing single-operation endpoints for backward compatibility
Provide per-subrequest SLO budgeting and fallback policies
Emit unified telemetry for composed requests: per-token, per-subrequest latency, cost, and model version
Support canary rollouts with 1% -> 10% -> 50% traffic ramps and automatic rollback on regression
non_goals: Replace user-implemented orchestrators for very large pipelines (>6 hops)
Guarantee deterministic outputs across models (we will provide evaluation hooks but not determinism at launch)
Support custom compute placement (Dedicated/Private support is post-launch)
scope: Include chat, completion, embedding, and rerank nodes. Implement runtime composition, prefix/KV cache reuse between nodes, per-node model hints and affinity, and basic error policies (retry, skip, fallback-to-compat-model). Ship Console UI: sample composer, per-portfolio analytics card, and rollout controls. Ship SDK changes for JavaScript and Python exposing the new request envelope and streaming behavior.
out_of_scope: Dedicated pool reservation, full on-prem installer, multi-tenant private VPC console controls, advanced scheduling knobs (kernel selection tuning) at GA.
api_contract: Streaming: support for node-level streaming when any node is generation-type; envelope begins with node headers and interleaved events
requirements: Runtime must support atomic execution semantics for the portfolio request with configurable partial-commit semantics
Console must show per-node latency and cost breakdown for the last 30 days
SDKs must provide ergonomic helpers to build portfolio graphs and surface streaming events
Telemetry schema must include portfolio_id, node_id, parent_trace, total_cost_tokens
Quota and rate-limit enforcement must consider portfolio token amplification and bill against a portfolio composite unit
acceptance_criteria: Functional: a composed test flow (embed->rerank->completion) returns correct node outputs and wiring in staging
Performance: end-to-end p95 latency improvement compared to chained calls >= 25% for benchmark flows at 10 RPS
Cost: median token cost per request is <= chained baseline token cost * 1.05 (no hidden multipliers)
Reliability: composition endpoint honors per-node timeouts and falls back to configured compatible model without failing whole request in 99% of injected timeout cases
Observability: Console shows per-node breakdown and portfolio traces are available in logs/trace UI within 15s of request completion
Security: threat modeling completed and SSO/KMS design reviewed by Security team; security_review_required == true
Backward compatibility: existing /v1/chat, /v1/completions, /v1/embeddings, /v1/rerank unchanged and their traffic unaffected by default routing
migration_plan: Stage 0 (internal alpha): runtime-only integration tests, no public surface
Stage 1 (private beta): 5 partner tenants enabled, manual monitoring and daily cadence
Stage 2 (canary): 1% of new traffic for all tier-1 tenants, automated regression gates
Stage 3 (ramped GA): progressive rollout over 7 days to 100% with rollout freezes for major holidays
rollout_checklist: Create feature flag portfoliaselect in console and backend
Ship SDK PRs: sdk-js #5832, sdk-py #1287 (links in attachments)
Create canary query set and baseline telemetry for 72h prior to canary
Register quality probes (generation coherence, semantic rerank accuracy) in Eval pipeline
Prepare ops runbook: rollback steps, model-compat mappings, emergency disable endpoint
Add dashboard with portfolio-specific SLOs: p50/p95 latency, error-rate, cost-per-request
Complete security review and KMS integration sign-off
Add docs: API reference, migration guide, console walkthrough
Prepare support playbook and training session for Solutions Engineers
Coordinate legal/finance for billing model change and update pricing page
metrics: Adoption: number of tenants creating >10 portfolios within first 30 days
Performance: p95 end-to-end latency for benchmark flows
Quality: rerank NDCG@10 delta compared to baseline
Cost: effective tokens billed per portal request vs chained baseline
Reliability: % of portfolios succeeding vs partial-fallback within 30 days
risks_mitigations: Risk: behavioral regressions introduced by model fallbacks -> Mitigation: block canary if eval regression > 1% on core prompts
Risk: token accounting confusion for customers -> Mitigation: clear cost breakdown in response and first-run console walkthrough
Risk: increased backend pressure from synchronous composition -> Mitigation: implement adaptive batching and circuit breaker per-tenant
Risk: SDK streaming semantics complexity -> Mitigation: surface helper libraries and example apps in repo
